title: Basal Insulin And Compensation Glycemic In Diabetic Patients In Basal Bolus Outpatient.
brief_summary: Multicentric, observational, cross-sectional study in Italy. The aims are to evaluate the basal/total ratio of daily insulin dose (b/T) in diabetic outpatients type 1 (T1) and type 2 (T2) on basal-bolus regimen, by investigating whether there is a relationship with HbA1c and episodes of hypoglycemia.
study_population: All diabetic patients respecting eligibility criteria
